description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' that abstracts Android's logging system, allowing other parts of the project to log messages with different priority levels and manage a chain of LogNode instances for handling log output.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A utility class for managing logging operations, providing static methods to log messages at various levels and manage LogNode chains.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode chain to which log messages will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates log messages to the current LogNode.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level.
